scope_subject: Project Checks — Dev Profile Sample Data Population

sources.description: Core schema defining all tables, partitions, constraints, triggers, and materialized views
check_templates table + 7 seed rows (precedent for seed-via-Flyway pattern)
Base Spring config — Flyway locations: classpath:db/migration
Local profile — Zonky embedded Postgres, dispatcher disabled
Direct user request for dev profile with standalone database and sample data for development and presentations

article_iv_gate.description: Every entry in this file traces to an existing schema artifact, configuration file, or the direct user request. No invented requirements. @pm attests.

functional.title: Dev Spring profile activates sample data on startup
functional.description: A `dev` Spring profile that, when activated via --spring.profiles.active=dev, populates the database with realistic sample data after Flyway versioned migrations complete.

traces.ref: Direct request for dev profile with sample data population

functional.title: Standalone embedded database for dev profile
functional.description: The dev profile reuses the Zonky embedded PostgreSQL from the local profile, requiring zero external dependencies (no Docker, no brew install). The database is ephemeral — destroyed on JVM shutdown.

functional.title: Sample data covers all core entities
functional.description: Seed data populates: users, csi_systems, checks (HTTP + TCP types at minimum), schedules, execution_results, reports, report_executions, ui_tests, ui_test_executions, tags, check_tags, csi_tags, secrets. All FK relationships satisfied.

traces.ref: Additional columns on reports and ui_tests

functional.title: Execution history demonstrates dashboard metrics
functional.description: Enough execution_results rows (mixed SUCCESS/FAILURE/WARNING/TIMEOUT) to produce meaningful csi_metrics_current materialized view data with varied health_percentage values across CSIs.

functional.title: Profile exclusivity — dev seed never runs outside dev
functional.description: Sample data SQL is only loaded when spring.profiles.active includes dev. Profiles local, test, staging, prod must NOT load seed data.

traces.ref: spring.flyway.locations controls which SQL directories Flyway scans

functional.title: Idempotent on repeated startups
functional.description: Running the application with dev profile multiple times (including against a persistent Postgres if configured) must not produce duplicate data or constraint violations.

traces.ref: Precedent: V3 uses INSERT with static IDs for idempotency

functional.title: Coherent demo narrative
functional.description: Data tells a realistic story: multiple CSI systems with varied health states (healthy, degraded, warning) to demonstrate dashboard drill-down, check management, and execution history during presentations.

functional.title: Execution results span multiple partitions
functional.description: Seeded execution_results target both the current month and at least one previous month partition to demonstrate the partitioning strategy during demos.

traces.ref: execution_results partitioned by RANGE on started_at

non_functional.title: Startup penalty <= 3 seconds
non_functional.description: The additional seed data population must add no more than 3 seconds to the application startup time compared to the local profile.

traces.ref: Implicit — dev workflow must remain fast

non_functional.title: No production code changes
non_functional.description: Dev seed data is fully isolated: new profile YAML + new SQL file in a dev-only Flyway location. Zero modifications to existing Java source, existing migrations, or non-dev profile configs.

non_functional.title: Passes ./gradlew check
non_functional.description: No regressions to Spotless, Checkstyle, SpotBugs, JaCoCo (80%), or RDS-parity lint.

non_functional.title: Realistic but non-sensitive data
non_functional.description: All sample data uses fictional names, emails, and URLs. No real Citi internal hostnames, employee names, or credentials.

non_functional.title: Self-documenting activation
non_functional.description: backend/README.md updated with dev profile usage instructions (one-liner command).

constraints.title: Seed data must NOT be a versioned migration
constraints.description: Flyway V* migrations are forward-only and run in all profiles. Seed data must use Flyway repeatable (R__) migration or another profile-gated mechanism.

constraints.title: Schema must be current before seed runs
constraints.description: hibernate.ddl-auto=validate means JPA validates entity mappings against the schema at startup. Seed data must only reference columns that exist after all V* migrations.

constraints.title: Execution results must target existing partitions
constraints.description: execution_results has no DEFAULT partition. INSERTs with started_at values outside existing partition bounds will fail. Seed data must dynamically target current month partitions.

traces.ref: PARTITION BY RANGE (started_at); no DEFAULT partition

constraints.title: JSONB must match sealed interface contracts
constraints.description: checks.configuration JSONB must include a $.type discriminator and match HttpConfiguration or TcpConfiguration field shapes exactly.

constraints.title: FK ordering in INSERT sequence
constraints.description: INSERT order must respect foreign key constraints: users -> csi_systems -> checks -> schedules -> execution_results -> tags -> check_tags/csi_tags -> reports -> report_executions -> ui_tests -> ui_test_executions -> secrets.

constraints.title: Unique constraints must be respected
constraints.description: Key uniqueness: users.sso_id UNIQUE, users.email UNIQUE (WHERE is_active), schedules.check_id UNIQUE, secrets.reference_id UNIQUE, tags.name UNIQUE.

constraints.title: Partition bootstrap runs before seed
constraints.description: PartitionScheduler.bootstrap() runs on ApplicationReadyEvent and creates partitions for current + 2 months. However, Flyway runs before Spring context is ready. The seed SQL must only target partitions created by V1__init.sql (2026_04, 2026_05) OR use CURRENT_DATE arithmetic that naturally falls within the bootstrap window.

assumptions_dependencies.description: Flyway supports spring.flyway.locations override per profile (documented in Flyway 9+ and Spring Boot 3.x)
Repeatable migrations (R__ prefix) run after all versioned migrations and re-run on checksum change
assumptions_dependencies.risk: LOW — core Flyway feature since v4

assumptions_dependencies.description: Zonky embedded Postgres starts with a clean database on each bootRun (no persistent state between runs)
assumptions_dependencies.risk: LOW — verified behavior in local profile

out_of_scope.description: Integration check types (SPLUNK, GRAFANA, ITRS, APPDYNAMICS) — seed only HTTP and TCP checks since these are the only implemented executors
Performance testing data (large volumes for load testing) — this is demo/dev seed data, not stress test fixtures
Frontend mock data alignment — MSW handlers have separate mock data; this spec covers backend only
CI profile changes — the test profile uses Testcontainers and does not need seed data
